name: BioAttend Flask Codespaces
postCreateCommand:
python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; fi && printf 'SERVER_URL=%s
API_TOKEN=%s
DISTANCE_THRESHOLD=0.60
EAR_THRESHOLD=0.25
BLINK_COUNT_REQUIRED=1
LIVENESS_TIMEOUT=5
LED_DURATION=1.0
GPIO_PIR=17
GPIO_LED_GREEN=27
GPIO_LED_RED=22
GPIO_BUZZER=23
CAMERA_WIDTH=1280
CAMERA_HEIGHT=720
DEBUG=True
FLASK_APP=app.py
FLASK_ENV=development
' "$SERVER_URL" "$API_TOKEN" > .env
